title: Comment policy
description: Schema for <home>/comment-policy.yaml, the team layer of the comment policy the code-tidying plugin's comment lint and /code-tidying:remove-comments read, and its personal override comment-policy.local.yaml. A key set here wins over the plugin's userConfig value of the same name; the personal override wins over the team file, except for the keys marked team file only. Resolution: plugins/code-tidying/reference/config.md.

comment_posture.description: Which comments /code-tidying:remove-comments keeps and the comment lint passes. auto: necessary. none: only machine-read directives, license headers, TODO(#issue) markers, paired records and public-API doc comments stay. necessary: the floor plus the keep list comment_keep_list resolves. explanatory: every comment that passes the earn-its-keep test. Deprecated, still resolved: strict and balanced read as explanatory, conservative as explanatory plus safe, aggressive as necessary.

comment_keep_list.description: What the necessary posture keeps above the floor. default: the shipped list, skills/remove-comments/reference/keep-list.md. Otherwise a repository-relative path to a file whose criteria replace the shipped list; the floor always stays. An absolute path, a .. segment, a symlink on the path or a path naming no regular file is invalid.

class_c_max_lines.description: Lines a kept linked comment paragraph may run: the comment lint fails a longer one, and remove-comments rewrites it terser.

comment_lint.description: Level of the comment lint, the git-hook entry comment-lint that judges the comment lines a change adds against comment_posture. off: it does not run. report: it prints its findings and passes. block: it prints them and fails. Team file only: the personal override is not read. It never runs under the explanatory posture.

comment_lint_allow.description: Extra comments the comment lint passes: each item is an extended regular expression matched against a comment's text, for markers a repository's own tools read. Team file only.

comment_lint_exclude.description: Repository-relative path globs of files the comment lint skips, each skip named on stderr; no other check reads it. * and ? match within one path segment, ** spans segments, every other character is literal. Keep each entry as narrow as the files need and state its justification beside it. Team file only.

comment_lint_keep_opening.description: Repository-relative path globs, in comment_lint_exclude's syntax, of files whose opening comment block the comment lint passes: the comment lines after an optional shebang and any blank or set - lines, up to the first other line. Every other comment in the file is judged as before. For a summary a person reads before running the file; keep each entry as narrow as those files need and state its justification beside it. Team file only.

comment_adr_dir.description: Repository-relative folder of the decision records an ADR pointer comment names; the comment lint passes a pointer only when its record exists there. A value outside the repository is ignored and the default applies. Team file only.
